checks.access_budget: Metadata only after all terminal or reviewed postmortem; separate 120-second/512MiB/single-worker/thread, no retry, E/model/oracle access forbidden.
checks.chronology: Explicitly written after C2 launch/three-epoch observations/one reported terminal; not retrospective experiment preregistration.
checks.costs: All original and C1/C2 opportunities, discarded partial work and failures charged; final nonoverlapping outer scopes, parallel calendar and uncertainty in original final CPU remain distinct.
checks.crossing: Original .30 target and first complete-epoch crossing retained; no before-training/epoch mixing, interpolation or successful-seed-only group median.
checks.memory: Per-attempt observed RSS and max across chain only; not summed peaks, GPU VRAM or memory exactly at a quality crossing.
checks.original_views: Copy/hash-check prior original42 and separate C1 views; missing remains missing; no C2-selected LR or later score retrofitted into 300/900/1800.
checks.terminal_selection: All six HCSN qualities independently verified before one all-three-seed mean/common LR; exact ties .001; no selected-seed or failed-fit deletion.
checks.training_scientific_separation: Producer and independent adequacy shown separately; all selected seeds needed for an adequately trained comparison; numerical/scientific/P5 gates unchanged.

cost_scope: Assembly prefix after interpreter imports; excludes manual reading, final serialization/archive and outer tool time. Complete manual-review/outer CPU and wall were not measured and remain unknown; no rerun was made to manufacture timing.

findings.evidence: c2_runner.epoch_clocks samples child elapsed once and returns cumulative_process_wall_seconds = parent_wall + elapsed. c2_controller finally records attempt_wrapper_wall_seconds and cumulative_parent_and_c2_active_wall_seconds separately.
findings.implication: Epoch quality coordinates are parent complete outer plus child process-prefix time; final training cost is parent complete outer plus whole attempt-wrapper time. They are not identical clock scopes.
findings.required_reporting: Label quality_clock_scope and terminal_cost_scope. Keep the original epoch timestamp; do not distribute or add the final wrapper difference to earlier target crossings. If exact wrapper-inclusive readiness is needed, state the unsupported offset/interval explicitly.

review_scope: Independent prose/rule review plus exact byte identities. No implementation or numerical/cost-curve result is approved by this preparation review.
